task: Turn your raw notes from today's Harbour Council project stand-up into clean notes for the Teams channel (60–100 words), with actions, owners and dates. Notes: "SQL migration done Tue. Raj: test reports by Thu. Firewall rule still not open, Tom to call council network team today. DNS change moved to next Mon."
zh: 把你今天 Harbour Council 项目站会的原始笔记整理成清晰的会议记录，发到 Teams 频道（60–100 词），写清行动项、负责人和日期。笔记：“SQL 迁移周二完成。Raj：周四前测试报表。防火墙规则还没开，Tom 今天给市政厅网络团队打电话。DNS 变更改到下周一。”
example:
Stand-up notes, Harbour Council, 20 November
Updates:
- The SQL migration was completed on Tuesday.
- The DNS change has moved to next Monday, 23 November.
Actions:
- Raj: test the reports on the new SQL server by Thursday 26 November.
- Tom: call the council's network team today about the firewall rule.
Open issue:
- The firewall rule is still not open. This blocks the app server migration.

task: Write a recap email (110–150 words) to Paul and his team after a discovery workshop with Harbour Council. Facts: 8 council staff attended. You listed 40 applications. Agreed priority: the rates system and the library system move first. Open question: who owns the old GIS system? Actions: Paul sends the server list by 27 November; you send the draft assessment by 11 December.
zh: 在和 Harbour Council 开完需求调研研讨会后，给 Paul 和他的团队写一封总结邮件（110–150 词）。事实：市政厅有 8 名员工参加。你们列出了 40 个应用。商定的优先级：费率系统和图书馆系统先迁。未决问题：旧的 GIS 系统归谁负责？行动项：Paul 在 11 月 27 日前发送服务器清单；你在 12 月 11 日前发送评估草稿。
example:
Hi Paul,
Thanks to you and the team for a really useful workshop today. Here's a quick recap.
What we covered:
- 8 people from the council attended, and together we listed 40 applications.
What we agreed:
- The rates system and the library system will move first, because they're the most important and the easiest to move.
Actions:
- Paul: send the full server list by 27 November.
- {name}: send the draft assessment by 11 December.
Open question:
- Who owns the old GIS system? No one in the room was sure. Could you find out who we should talk to?
If I've missed or misunderstood anything, just let me know.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write the minutes (80–120 words) of the Kauri Foods payroll steering meeting. Attendees: Mark (sponsor), Lisa (IT manager), Tom (PM), you. Notes: "Status amber, data 1 wk behind. Decision: go-live stays 1 Mar. Decision: approve extra $4k for data cleaning. Lisa to confirm UAT testers by 4 Dec. Tom to update plan by Fri. Next meeting 18 Dec."
zh: 写一份 Kauri Foods 薪资项目指导委员会会议的会议纪要（80–120 词）。参会人：Mark（发起人）、Lisa（IT 经理）、Tom（项目经理）、你。笔记：“状态黄，数据落后 1 周。决定：上线仍为 3 月 1 日。决定：批准额外 4 千元用于数据清理。Lisa 12 月 4 日前确认 UAT 测试人员。Tom 周五前更新计划。下次会议 12 月 18 日。”
example:
Kauri Foods payroll upgrade: steering meeting minutes, 20 November
Attendees: Mark (sponsor), Lisa (IT manager), Tom (project manager), {name}
Status:
- Overall Amber. Data migration is one week behind because of duplicate records.
Decisions:
- The go-live date stays at 1 March.
- Mark approved an extra $4,000 for data cleaning.
Actions:
- Lisa: confirm the names of the UAT testers by 4 December.
- Tom: update the project plan with the new data cleaning work by Friday 27 November.
Next meeting: Friday 18 December.

task: Write clean notes (90–130 words) from a design review for the Coastal Dental network. Notes: "Hub and spoke agreed. Firewall: Azure Firewall Basic, not 3rd party (cost). VPN not ExpressRoute for now, review in 12 months. ? IP range clash with clinic in Hamilton, Raj to check by Wed. Sarah to update design doc v0.3 by Fri."
zh: 把 Coastal Dental 网络设计评审的笔记整理清楚（90–130 词）。笔记：“同意用中心辐射（hub and spoke）结构。防火墙：用 Azure Firewall Basic，不用第三方（成本）。目前用 VPN 不用 ExpressRoute，12 个月后再评估。？和汉密尔顿诊所的 IP 段可能冲突，Raj 周三前确认。Sarah 周五前把设计文档更新到 v0.3。”
example:
Coastal Dental network design review: notes
Decisions:
- We'll use a hub and spoke network design.
- Firewall: Azure Firewall Basic, not a third-party firewall, mainly because of cost.
- Connection to the clinics: site-to-site VPN for now, not ExpressRoute. We'll review this in 12 months, when we know more about traffic.
Open question:
- The planned IP range may clash with the Hamilton clinic's network.
Actions:
- Raj: check the Hamilton IP range and confirm if there's a clash by Wednesday.
- Sarah: update the design document to v0.3 with these decisions by Friday.
Please let me know if I've missed anything.

task: Write a short summary (60–100 words) for your manager Grace after a call with the backup software vendor. Notes: "New version out Jan. Fixes our restore bug. Price same. Need to upgrade agents on all 30 servers. Vendor sends upgrade guide this wk. Me: plan upgrade for Feb."
zh: 和备份软件供应商通完电话后，给经理 Grace 写一份简短总结（60–100 词）。笔记：“新版本一月发布。修复了我们遇到的恢复问题。价格不变。30 台服务器上的代理都要升级。供应商这周发升级指南。我：二月安排升级。”
example:
Hi Grace,
Quick summary of today's call with the backup vendor.
- Their new version comes out in January, and it fixes the restore bug we've been having.
- The price stays the same.
- We'll need to upgrade the agent on all 30 servers.
Actions:
- Vendor: send the upgrade guide this week.
- Me: plan the upgrade for February, after the change freeze.
Overall, good news. I'll share the plan once I have the guide.
Cheers,
{name}

words.zh: 修复了我们的恢复问题

task: Write the notes (70–110 words) from your team's sprint planning meeting for the Teams channel. Notes: "Sprint 7, 2 wks, ends 4 Dec. Goal: finish cost reports + backup alerts. Raj on leave Thu–Fri. Ben: alerts. Aroha + me: cost report. Demo 4 Dec 10am."
zh: 把团队冲刺规划会的笔记整理后发到 Teams 频道（70–110 词）。笔记：“冲刺 7，两周，12 月 4 日结束。目标：完成成本报表和备份告警。Raj 周四到周五休假。Ben：告警。Aroha 和我：成本报表。演示 12 月 4 日上午 10 点。”
example:
Sprint 7 planning notes
Sprint 7 runs for two weeks and ends on Friday 4 December.
Sprint goal: finish the cost reports and the backup alerts. Both were carried over from sprint 6.
Who's doing what:
- Ben: backup alerts.
- Aroha and {name}: cost reports.
Things to know:
- Raj is on leave on Thursday and Friday this week, so please don't assign him new tickets.
- The demo is on 4 December at 10am.
Shout if anything looks wrong.

task: Write the notes (120–160 words) from a post-incident review of the Harbour Council portal outage. Notes: "Outage 9:40–10:25, 45 min. Cause: cert expired on App Gateway. Why missed: renewal reminder went to old shared mailbox nobody checks. Good: alert fired in 3 min. Actions: auto-renew via Key Vault (Raj, 4 Dec); update contact list (Paul, 27 Nov); check all certs (me, 30 Nov). No blame."
zh: 写一份 Harbour Council 门户故障事后复盘的会议记录（120–160 词）。笔记：“故障 9:40–10:25，45 分钟。原因：应用网关证书过期。为什么没发现：续期提醒发到了一个没人看的旧共享邮箱。做得好的：3 分钟内就告警了。行动项：通过 Key Vault 自动续期（Raj，12 月 4 日）；更新联系人列表（Paul，11 月 27 日）；检查所有证书（我，11 月 30 日）。不追责。”
example:
Post-incident review: Harbour Council portal outage
This was a no-blame review. The aim is to learn, not to find someone at fault.
What happened:
- The customer portal was down from 9:40 to 10:25am, 45 minutes in total.
- The cause was an expired certificate on the Application Gateway.
Why we missed it:
- The renewal reminder went to an old shared mailbox that nobody checks any more.
What went well:
- Our monitoring alert fired within 3 minutes, so we started work quickly.
Actions:
- Raj: set up automatic certificate renewal from Key Vault by 4 December.
- Paul: update the contact list so reminders go to a mailbox people actually read, by 27 November.
- {name}: check every certificate in the environment and list their expiry dates by 30 November.
We'll check progress on these at the next weekly meeting.

task: Write a recap email (100–140 words) to Janet, the practice manager at Coastal Dental, after the project kick-off meeting. Facts: project goal is to move their 6 servers to Azure by March. Weekly check-in every Tuesday at 9am. Janet is the main contact; Dr Patel signs off on costs. Actions: Janet sends the list of software vendors by 4 December; you send the project plan by 1 December.
zh: 在项目启动会后，给 Coastal Dental 的诊所经理 Janet 写一封总结邮件（100–140 词）。事实：项目目标是 3 月前把他们的 6 台服务器迁到 Azure。每周二上午 9 点例会。Janet 是主要联系人；Patel 医生负责审批费用。行动项：Janet 在 12 月 4 日前发送软件供应商名单；你在 12 月 1 日前发送项目计划。
example:
Hi Janet,
Thanks for your time at today's kick-off. It was great to meet the team. Here's a short recap.
Project goal:
- Move your 6 servers to Azure by March.
How we'll work:
- Weekly check-in every Tuesday at 9am, 30 minutes on Teams.
- You're our main contact for day-to-day questions.
- Dr Patel will sign off on anything that affects cost.
Actions:
- Janet: send the list of software vendors and their contact details by 4 December.
- {name}: send the project plan by 1 December.
If anything here doesn't match your notes, just let me know. Looking forward to working with you.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write notes (60–100 words) from your one-on-one with your manager Grace, to send to her afterwards. Notes: "Feedback good on Kauri. Want to do AZ-305 by April, Grace ok, study time 2 hrs/wk. Next qtr: more client-facing work. Me: book exam. Grace: ask Tom re presales."
zh: 把你和经理 Grace 一对一会议的笔记整理好，会后发给她（60–100 词）。笔记：“Kauri 项目反馈不错。想在四月前考 AZ-305，Grace 同意，每周 2 小时学习时间。下季度：多做面对客户的工作。我：报名考试。Grace：问 Tom 售前的事。”
example:
Hi Grace,
Thanks for the chat today. Here are my notes so we're on the same page.
- Feedback from Kauri Foods has been good.
- I'd like to pass AZ-305 by April. You're happy with that, and I can use 2 hours a week for study.
- Next quarter I'll take on more client-facing work.
Actions:
- Me: book the exam this month.
- You: ask Tom about me joining some presales meetings.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write a recap email (100–140 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods after a call where she complained about slow responses to support tickets. Facts: three tickets last week took over 2 days to get a reply. You agreed: urgent tickets will get a phone call within 1 hour; you'll send a weekly ticket report; you'll review in one month.
zh: Lisa 在电话里投诉支持工单回复太慢，通话后给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一封总结邮件（100–140 词）。事实：上周有三个工单超过 2 天才得到回复。你们约定：紧急工单 1 小时内电话联系；你每周发一份工单报告；一个月后复查。
example:
Hi Lisa,
Thanks for talking to me today, and for being so clear about the problem. I'm sorry about the slow responses.
What went wrong:
- Three of your tickets last week took more than 2 days to get a reply. That's not the service you should expect from us.
What we agreed:
- Urgent tickets will get a phone call from an engineer within 1 hour.
- I'll send you a short ticket report every Friday, so you can see what's open and who's working on it.
- We'll review how it's going in one month, on 18 December.
If anything urgent comes up before then, please call me directly.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write notes (80–120 words) from a monthly cost review meeting for Harbour Council. Notes: "Oct spend $14.2k, budget $12.5k. Test VMs now auto shut down. Agreed: buy 1-yr reserved instances for 6 prod VMs, saves ~$1.1k/mth. Paul to get finance OK by 4 Dec. Log retention 30 days non-prod, me by 27 Nov."
zh: 把 Harbour Council 月度成本评审会的笔记整理清楚（80–120 词）。笔记：“10 月花费 1.42 万，预算 1.25 万。测试虚拟机现已自动关机。同意：为 6 台生产虚拟机购买一年期预留实例，每月约省 1.1 千。Paul 12 月 4 日前拿到财务批准。非生产环境日志保留 30 天，我 11 月 27 日前完成。”
example:
Harbour Council cost review: notes, 20 November
Where we are:
- October spend was $14,200 against a budget of $12,500.
- Test VMs now shut down automatically at night and at weekends, so November should be lower.
Decision:
- We'll buy 1-year reserved instances for the 6 production VMs. This should save about $1,100 a month.
Actions:
- Paul: get approval from finance for the reserved instances by 4 December.
- {name}: reduce log retention to 30 days for non-production by 27 November.
Next review: mid-December, once we have the November bill.

task: Write notes (110–150 words) from a security workshop with Kauri Foods, with a clear list of open questions. Notes: "Agreed MFA for all staff by Feb. Admin accounts: separate accounts, PIM. ? Shared warehouse PCs: MFA how? ? Who approves admin access? ? Keep logs how long, any legal need? Lisa to answer qs by 4 Dec. Me: draft policy by 11 Dec."
zh: 把和 Kauri Foods 安全研讨会的笔记整理好，并清楚列出未决问题（110–150 词）。笔记：“同意二月前所有员工启用 MFA。管理员账号：单独账号，用 PIM。？仓库共用电脑：MFA 怎么做？？谁批准管理员权限？？日志保留多久，有没有法律要求？Lisa 12 月 4 日前回答这些问题。我：12 月 11 日前起草策略。”
example:
Kauri Foods security workshop: notes
What we agreed:
- All staff will use MFA by February.
- Admins will have separate admin accounts, and admin rights will be given only when needed, using Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
Open questions:
1. Shared PCs in the warehouse: how should staff do MFA on a PC that several people use? Options include hardware keys or a fixed location rule.
2. Who should approve requests for admin access: Lisa, or the person's manager?
3. How long do logs need to be kept? Is there any legal or audit reason to keep them longer than 90 days?
Actions:
- Lisa: answer the three questions above by 4 December.
- {name}: send a draft security policy by 11 December, based on the answers.
Thanks everyone for a productive session.

task: Write the notes (80–120 words) from the go/no-go meeting for the Kauri Foods payroll cutover. Notes: "Decision GO. 2 open defects, both low impact, workaround agreed. Rollback plan checked. Cutover Sat 8am. Lisa: tell staff Fri. Tom: on call Sat. Next check-in Sat 2pm."
zh: 把 Kauri Foods 薪资系统割接的“上线 / 不上线”决策会议笔记整理好（80–120 词）。笔记：“决定上线。2 个未解决缺陷，影响都小，已商定临时方案。回滚计划已检查。周六早上 8 点割接。Lisa：周五通知员工。Tom：周六值班。下次碰头周六下午 2 点。”
example:
Kauri Foods payroll cutover: go/no-go notes
Decision: GO. The cutover goes ahead on Saturday at 8am.
Why:
- Only 2 defects are still open, both low impact, and we've agreed a workaround for each.
- The rollback plan has been checked and is ready if we need it.
Actions:
- Lisa: tell all staff about the cutover on Friday.
- Tom: be on call all day Saturday.
Next check-in: Saturday at 2pm, on the usual Teams link.
Thanks, everyone. Fingers crossed for a quiet weekend.

task: Write notes (90–130 words) from the handover meeting between the Harbour Council project team and the managed services team. Notes: "Handover docs in SharePoint. Support starts 1 Dec. Known issues: 2 (VPN drops Ōrewa, slow report). Backups checked daily by support. Raj = contact for 2 wks after. Ben to add servers to monitoring by 30 Nov."
zh: 把 Harbour Council 项目团队和托管服务团队之间交接会议的笔记整理好（90–130 词）。笔记：“交接文档在 SharePoint。支持服务 12 月 1 日开始。已知问题：2 个（Ōrewa VPN 掉线，报表慢）。支持团队每天检查备份。之后两周 Raj 是联系人。Ben 11 月 30 日前把服务器加入监控。”
example:
Harbour Council handover to managed services: notes
Key points:
- All handover documents are in the Harbour Council SharePoint site, in the Handover folder.
- Managed services support starts on 1 December.
- The support team will check backups every day.
Known issues being handed over:
- VPN drops at the Ōrewa office. A Microsoft case is open.
- The monthly rates report is slow. A fix is planned for January.
Actions:
- Ben: add all servers to monitoring by 30 November.
- Raj: be the contact for project questions for two weeks after handover, until 14 December.
Please raise any questions in the handover channel.

task: After a requirements call with Janet at Coastal Dental, write an email (60–100 words) listing only the open questions she needs to answer. Notes: "? how many staff work remotely ? does imaging software need GPU ? backup: how many yrs to keep patient records ? any planned new clinics next yr"
zh: 和 Coastal Dental 的 Janet 开完需求电话会后，写一封邮件（60–100 词），只列出她需要回答的未决问题。笔记：“？多少员工远程办公？影像软件需要 GPU 吗？备份：病人记录要保留几年？明年有没有计划开新诊所？”
example:
Hi Janet,
Thanks for the call today. There are four questions we still need answers to before we can finish the design:
1. How many staff work remotely, and how often?
2. Does your imaging software need a graphics card (GPU)?
3. How many years do you need to keep patient records for?
4. Are you planning to open any new clinics next year?
If you could reply by next Friday, that would be great.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: so we can size it correctly

task: Write a recap email (90–130 words) to Lisa and her team after you demoed the new AVD desktops to Kauri Foods. Facts: 12 people attended. They liked the speed and single sign-on. Concerns: label printers and working offline. Agreed: pilot extended by one week to test printing. Next demo on 4 December.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 演示了新的 AVD 桌面后，给 Lisa 和她的团队写一封总结邮件（90–130 词）。事实：12 人参加。他们喜欢速度快和单点登录。顾虑：标签打印机和离线办公。约定：试点延长一周来测试打印。下次演示在 12 月 4 日。
example:
Hi Lisa,
Thanks to you and the team for coming to today's AVD demo. Twelve people attended, and the feedback was really helpful.
What people liked:
- The speed, especially opening large Excel files.
- Single sign-on, so they only log in once.
Concerns raised:
- Label printers in the warehouse. We need to test these properly.
- Working offline. AVD needs an internet connection, so we'll suggest options for staff who travel.
What we agreed:
- The pilot is extended by one week so we can test printing.
- The next demo is on 4 December, where we'll show the printing fix.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write notes (90–130 words) from the lessons-learned session at the end of the Coastal Dental project. Notes: "Went well: weekly check-ins, early testing. Didn't: vendor slow to reply, scope of printers unclear. Next time: get vendor contacts in kick-off, list all devices in discovery. Owner of lessons doc: me."
zh: 把 Coastal Dental 项目结束时经验总结会的笔记整理好（90–130 词）。笔记：“做得好：每周例会、提早测试。做得不好：供应商回复慢，打印机范围不清楚。下次：启动会时就拿到供应商联系方式，需求调研时列出所有设备。经验文档负责人：我。”
example:
Coastal Dental project: lessons learned
What went well:
- Weekly check-ins with Janet kept everyone on the same page, and problems came up early.
- Starting testing early meant we found the imaging software issue weeks before go-live.
What didn't go well:
- The software vendor was slow to reply, which cost us about a week.
- The scope for printers wasn't clear, so we had to add work late in the project.
What we'll do next time:
- Get contact details for all vendors at the kick-off meeting.
- List every device, including printers and scanners, during discovery.
I'll add these to the lessons learned document and share it with the team by Friday.

task: Write the minutes (110–150 words) of the monthly service review with Paul at Harbour Council. Notes: "SLA met, 99.95% uptime. Tickets 34 in / 31 closed. Paul unhappy re: VPN at Ōrewa, wants fix plan by 4 Dec. Agreed: Win 2016 upgrade project, quote by 11 Dec. Paul: confirm budget for 2027. Next review 17 Dec."
zh: 写一份和 Harbour Council 的 Paul 召开的月度服务评审会的会议纪要（110–150 词）。笔记：“达到 SLA，可用率 99.95%。工单进 34 个 / 关 31 个。Paul 对 Ōrewa 的 VPN 不满意，要求 12 月 4 日前给出修复计划。约定：Win 2016 升级项目，12 月 11 日前报价。Paul：确认 2027 年预算。下次评审 12 月 17 日。”
example:
Harbour Council monthly service review: minutes, 19 November
Attendees: Paul (IT manager), {name}
Performance:
- All SLAs were met. Uptime was 99.95%.
- 34 tickets were raised and 31 closed.
Issues raised:
- Paul is not happy with the ongoing VPN drops at the Ōrewa office. Staff there have been affected for over a month. He asked for a clear plan to fix it.
Decisions:
- We'll start a project to upgrade the 8 servers on Windows Server 2016.
Actions:
- {name}: send a fix plan for the Ōrewa VPN by 4 December.
- {name}: send a quote for the Windows Server 2016 upgrade by 11 December.
- Paul: confirm the IT budget for 2027.
Next review: Thursday 17 December.

task: Write notes (80–120 words) from a licensing discussion with Lisa at Kauri Foods. Notes: "Now 150 users on M365 E3. 40 warehouse staff only need email + Teams, could move to F3, saves ~$1,500/mth. Lisa ok in principle, wants to check with HR. Me: send comparison table by 27 Nov. Decide at Dec meeting."
zh: 把和 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 讨论许可证的笔记整理好（80–120 词）。笔记：“目前 150 个用户用 M365 E3。40 名仓库员工只需要邮件和 Teams，可以换成 F3，每月约省 1,500 元。Lisa 原则上同意，想先和人力资源确认。我：11 月 27 日前发对比表。十二月会议上决定。”
example:
Kauri Foods licensing discussion: notes
Current position:
- 150 users are on Microsoft 365 E3.
Idea discussed:
- About 40 warehouse staff only use email and Teams. They could move to the cheaper F3 licence, which would save about $1,500 a month.
Where we landed:
- Lisa is happy with the idea in principle but wants to check with HR first, in case any warehouse staff need the full Office apps.
Actions:
- {name}: send a table comparing E3 and F3 by 27 November.
- Lisa: check with HR before the December meeting.
Decision: to be made at the December monthly meeting.

task: Write a follow-up email (80–120 words) after a meeting with Harbour Council where nothing was decided. The topic was whether to move their GIS system to Azure. Facts: the GIS team wasn't in the meeting, and nobody knew the licence terms. Next steps: Paul invites the GIS lead; you check the licence with the vendor. New meeting in two weeks.
zh: 和 Harbour Council 开了一个没做出任何决定的会议后，写一封跟进邮件（80–120 词）。议题是要不要把他们的 GIS 系统迁到 Azure。事实：GIS 团队没来开会，也没人清楚许可证条款。下一步：Paul 邀请 GIS 负责人；你向供应商核实许可证。两周后再开会。
example:
Hi Paul,
Thanks for today's meeting about the GIS system. We didn't reach a decision, which makes sense given what we don't know yet.
The two gaps are:
- The GIS team wasn't in the room, so we don't know how they use the system day to day.
- Nobody was sure whether the GIS licence allows it to run in Azure.
